description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

PayPal, through its Venmo subsidiary, provides payment and financial services that connect consumers and merchants globally. The Software Engineer will help build and maintain AI-powered tools, cloud infrastructure, automation, and services supporting Venmo’s AWS environment, while contributing to CI/CD, SRE, and DevOps initiatives.
Cloud infrastructure engineer building automation, CI/CD pipelines, and self-service DevOps tooling

Responsibilities:
• Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff
• Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures
• Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions
• Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions
• May contribute to code & design reviews
• Contribute to infrastructure features and automation under guidance of senior engineers
• Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot incidents, and escalate as appropriate
• Write automation scripts and infrastructure-as-code to improve operational efficiency
• Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, self-service tooling, and microservices scaffolding
• Learn and apply best practices in cloud engineering, DevOps, and SRE
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable solutions

Requirements:
• 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience
• Bachelor's in computer science or related field of study
• 1+ years' experience in software development or a related field
• Programming and scripting experience (Python, Bash, Go, or similar)
• Exposure to containers and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
• Strong communication skills and eagerness to learn

Preferred:
• Some experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) or container technologies
